findings.issue: `cohomologyEquivOfIso_apply` and `cohomologyEquivOfIso_symm_apply` (line 91) are the general simp lemmas `Iso.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv_apply` / `_symm_apply` specialized to one functor — the proofs are `rw [← Functor.mapIso_hom]; exact <the general lemma>`, i.e. they state nothing that simp does not already do.

summary: Cohomology, functorH and the H⁰ identification sit at the right generality (all of X.Modules, all degrees), but the cohomologyEquivOfIso block re-derives, for one functor, a result Mathlib already states for every functor into AddCommGrpCat, with no in-repo or roadmap use.
